## Why Grizzly Bears?

The California grizzly bear was declared extinct in 1922 — hunted to 
elimination within decades of European settlement. Yet it remains on 
our state flag. I believe restoring the grizzly is not just an 
ecological question — it is a question of justice, history, and what 
we owe to the land. I have written a lesson plan for california elementary schoolers to learn about the Senate Bill 1305, TEK and possible reintroduction of the grizzly bear. 

## Historical Range of the California Grizzly

Click the markers to learn about each region!

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(leaflet)

historical_range <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Coast Ranges", "Central Valley", "Sierra Nevada",
    "Klamath Mountains", "Transverse Ranges", "Peninsular Ranges"
  ),
  lat = c(37.5, 36.7, 37.8, 41.2, 34.3, 33.5),
  lng = c(-122.0, -119.7, -119.3, -123.0, -117.8, -116.8),
  description = c(
    "Coastal grizzly habitat — bears foraged on beached whales and acorns",
    "Once the most densely populated grizzly region in North America",
    "High elevation summer range along the Sierra Nevada",
    "Northern California mountains — last stronghold before extinction",
    "Southern California mountains including the San Gabriel range",
    "Southern range extending toward Baja California"
  )
)

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
  setView(lng = -119.5, lat = 37.5, zoom = 6) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = historical_range,
    lat = ~lat, lng = ~lng,
    radius = 18,
    color = "#8B4513",
    fillColor = "#CD853F",
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    weight = 2,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", description)
  ) |>
  addMarkers(
    lng = -119.5, lat = 38.5,
    popup = "<b>Proposed Reintroduction Zone</b><br>
    The Northern Sierra Nevada and surrounding public lands 
    are considered prime candidates for grizzly reintroduction 
    under SB 1305."
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#CD853F", "#2d6a4f"),
    labels = c("Historical grizzly range", "Proposed reintroduction zone"),
    title = "Grizzly Bear in California"
  )
```
